supporting_observations.claim: WS-LMARTINS-01 made repeated TCP connections to PROXY-NWD-01 on port 8080 at approximately five-minute intervals during the alert period; the records identify the service as HTTP to the proxy, not the ultimate external destination.

The connection cadence is consistent with the approximately five-minute update checks described for approved PixelForge software, but these network records do not identify PixelForge or attribute the connections to its updater.

The records also show successful machine-account Kerberos authentication and SMB sessions between WS-LMARTINS-01 and DC-NWD-01 during the review window; these records alone do not establish malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-status information reports a collection outage for WS-LMARTINS-01 winsec and Sysmon, and for PROXY-NWD-01 proxy logs, from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC. This overlaps the alert period and prevents endpoint process attribution and proxy-level destination/request review.

The provided Zeek connection records show client-to-proxy connections but do not include the proxied destination or establish the application responsible. Although Zeek SSL and DNS sensors are reported as available, no corresponding SSL or DNS records for these connections are included in the supplied evidence.
claims_not_established: Whether the proxy sessions reached updates.pixelforge-suite.com or another destination.
Whether pfupdater.exe or another approved application initiated the sessions.
Whether the sessions carried malicious content, command-and-control traffic, or data exfiltration.
Whether any suspicious endpoint activity occurred during the endpoint logging outage.
additional_evidence_needed: Proxy logs for the affected interval, including CONNECT or URL host, destination, request details, and client identity.
Zeek SSL records and relevant DNS records for the same sessions, including SNI and certificate details where available.
WS-LMARTINS-01 endpoint process-creation and network-attribution telemetry covering 13:30–14:10 UTC.
PixelForge updater logs and executable verification data, such as file hash, signature status, and update history.
